laws.rule: In Brijuni National Park, visitors must keep to marked trails and the park's own transfers and tours; climbing on monuments, removing archaeological finds or fossils, feeding animals, camping, campfires and smoking outdoors (except on restaurant terraces) are banned, and swimming is only at marked bathing areas. Commercial photography or filming needs the park's permission, and park wardens may check tickets and ID.
laws.heading: Javna ustanova Nacionalni park Brijuni, Code of conduct

laws.rule: Brijuni National Park: dogs require a dog ticket and a lead and may enter only specified areas. The code identifies a 50 m dog-swimming area near Veli Brijun harbour; check the park map and access conditions.
Brijuni National Park: bringing a private bicycle or scooter to the island requires notice at least 24 hours ahead, and a transport fee applies.
